                  getOriginBootloadCrc PROC
;;;438    uint32_t getOriginBootloadCrc(void){//计算MCU Bootload CRC32
000cec  b570              PUSH     {r4-r6,lr}
;;;439    	uint8_t val;
;;;440    	uint32_t i;
;;;441    	uint32_t crc32;
